# trufo_certificates (Data Source)

Lists the organization's certificates (`POST /cert/list`). Requires a Bearer access token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "trufo_certificates" "all" {}

output "active_certs" {
  value = [for c in data.trufo_certificates.all.certs : c.serial_number if c.revocation_status == "good"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `certs` (Attributes List) The certificates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certs))
- `id` (String) Stable identifier for this list (hash of the certificate serial numbers).
